content: The diagnostic criteria for diabetes, as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), are as follows: 1. A1C Test: A hemoglobin A1C level of 6. 2. Fasting Plasma Glucose (FPG): A fasting plasma glucose level of 126 mg/dL or higher (≥7.0 mmol/L) after a minimum of 8 hours without caloric intake is diagnostic of diabetes. 3. 2-Hour Plasma Glucose (2-h PG) during an Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT): A plasma glucose level of 200 mg/dL or higher (≥11. 4. Random Plasma Glucose: In individuals presenting with classic symptoms of hyperglycemia (such as polyuria, polydipsia, and unexplained weight loss), a random plasma glucose level of 200 mg/dL or higher (≥11.1 mmol/L) is diagnostic of diabetes.
